notes: Review follow-up of 03 T6 (docs/improvements/03-pivot.md 3.2; AC 18): the two role="switch" toggles of the Wall Pivot panel get an accessible name, aria-labelledby pointing at their visible .toggle-label span (which gains an id), so assistive technology announces 'Keep stage layout on pivot change, switch, on' instead of an unnamed switch. Neither attribute is rendered or recorded by any probe (toggle_aria records role, aria-checked and tabindex; the ui_visual text probe records aria-label, title and data-* attributes, not aria-labelledby or span ids), so this is an invariance gate: every output must stay identical.
